project.name: Prismatic MCP Server
project.tagline: Research-only, loopback-only, compile-gated Model Context Protocol server embedded in this OpenTTD fork
project.status_summary: A real, compiling, connectable read-only vertical, plus approval-gated mutations: openttd.game.set_pause, one openttd.cmd.<Name> tool per game command whose parameters convert from JSON, the company AIs (openttd.ai.*) and Script API calls with execute (openttd.api.*), each through a two-phase approval bound to its exact arguments. The fork's own toolbar button and menu are in the game. See 05-implementation-plan.md for the honest per-phase status. The Control Center window, per-client company scoping, SSE and full conformance evidence are staged, not implemented.

cta.label: Get started: Prismatic MCP for contributors
cta.subtext: Research-only · loopback-only · compile-gated. Read AGENTS.md before touching anything.

getting_started_steps.title: Read the ground rules first
getting_started_steps.detail: AGENTS.md (vendor-neutral ground rules for any agent/contributor working in this fork), then CLAUDE.md.

getting_started_steps.title: Read the MCP research trail
getting_started_steps.detail: research/prismatic-mcp/README.md is the entry point; 00-baseline.md through 19-continuation-runbook.md are phase-ordered.

getting_started_steps.title: Configure with the feature gate ON
getting_started_steps.detail: OPTION_PRISMATIC_MCP_SERVER defaults OFF and requires OPTION_RESEARCH_INSTRUMENTATION=ON. The system compiler is used; only a macOS Command Line Tools install older than Xcode 15 needs Homebrew LLVM through CC/CXX (ADR 0006, research/tooling.md).

getting_started_steps.title: Run the unit tests
getting_started_steps.detail: Catch2 tests tagged [prismatic_mcp] (security helpers, the approval state machine, command parameter conversion, the toolbar menu, the console family) are ctest-discoverable.
getting_started_steps.command: cmake --build build-mcp --target openttd_test -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu) && ctest --test-dir build-mcp -R prismatic --output-on-failure

getting_started_steps.title: Start the server and connect
getting_started_steps.detail: In the in-game console: prismatic_mcp start, then prismatic_mcp token to get the bearer token, and prismatic_mcp approve <id> or deny <id> for a pending mutation. Never share the token; it is never logged.

getting_started_steps.title: Run the local validation gate before proposing a change

known_limitations: The native Control Center window is not implemented; the toolbar button and its menu are (I0072).

Multi-AI play runs outside the MCP server's authorization model: tools/research/mcp-duel plays two bots in one game, the LAN AI battle (research/ai-battle/README.md, feature status draft) runs headless free-for-all matches through existing interfaces, and the live arena (research/live-arena.md) runs one watched game. None gives each player its own MCP client with a company-scoped authorization.

Every mutation needs an operator approval in the console ('prismatic_mcp approve <id>'). A command tool takes a company actor, but there is no per-client company-scoped authorization and no action budget.
Saving a game is not an action type: it is not a game command, so it is not in the catalogue.

The doc index is checked against the documents in research/prismatic-mcp/ (Markdown and JSON, as git lists them): the generator refuses to run, and tools/check-prismatic-docs.sh fails, while one is missing or an entry names no document. A new document's title and kind are still written here by hand.
